Priyom,

Thanks for the context and the COI form. My read: we can accept the request with two clarifications that should be communicated to the broker and Novus. Here is the language I recommend sending to both parties (keeps exposure bounded and meets Novus's audit needs):

1) Additional Insured endorsement: Redwood will provide an Additional Insured endorsement naming 'Novus Analytics, Inc. and its subsidiaries' as Additional Insured on the policy(ies) identified in the COI. Acceptable proof: either ISO CG 20 10 or a long-form equivalent; if insurer provides an equivalent, broker must attach the endorsement document to the COI delivery.

2) Primary/non-contributory: Redwood requests that the endorsement be issued on a primary and non-contributory basis only to the extent allowed by the insurer's policy wording and local law. If the insurer refuses, they should include a short statement on the COI explaining the limitation.

3) Waiver of subrogation: Redwood will accept a waiver of subrogation for Workers' Compensation where permitted by law. If not permitted, broker should note the legal restriction on the COI.

4) COI delivery and attachments: Broker should send a PDF COI and any applicable endorsement documents to contracts@redwood.com and cc: contracts@novusanalytics.com. The COI must reference the HubSpot Deal ID ND-2026-0918 in the certificate notes.

I'll approve these points for sign-off. Priyom — please send the language below to your broker and to Elena so they have a single instruction set. If Novus still requires a 'long-form' endorsement as a hard prerequisite, we'll request a short exception in the MSA to allow Redwood's broker to provide equivalent ISO or insurer-supplied endorsements.

Suggested email text you can forward:

"Per contract review, Redwood will provide Additional Insured coverage naming 'Novus Analytics, Inc. and its subsidiaries' via ISO CG 20 10 or equivalent. The endorsement must be attached to the COI. Primary/non-contributory and waiver of subrogation will be provided to the extent permitted by policy language and applicable law; any limitation must be noted on the COI. Please send COI + endorsements as PDF to contracts@redwood.com and cc contracts@novusanalytics.com, and reference Deal ND-2026-0918."

Priyom: once you have confirmation from the broker that they can attach the endorsement document, we can tell Novus this is ready for countersignature.
